title: HandLive — call_event/app_call (S→C, no ack)
description: CALL-05 API 1: a call from another app on the phone (Telegram…), read from the app's call notification by A-CALL's NotificationListenerService. Sent to every session for which features.call.app_calls is in effect (Mac only; iPhone/iPad report false), on every change of the app-call context, latest wins per call_id; ended is sent once, then the context is forgotten. Never in a push. caller is personal data: E2E only, never logged, never stored. The allOf rules restate the context rules of API 1.

app.description: The calling app: its Android package name and its label from PackageManager (display only, cut to 64 characters).

controls.description: Actions the Mac may send with call_event/action: answer and decline while ringing, from the answer and decline intents of the ringing notification; end while ongoing, when the in-call notification has an end action (its android.hangUpIntent, else its only action).

app-call-data.description: Every field is always present (null where the spec allows it).

call_id.description: One per app call; stays the same from ringing to ongoing to ended.

caller.description: callPerson.name of the CallStyle notification, else its title, cut to 128 characters; null when absent, never an empty string.

state.description: ringing (CallStyle callType 1), ongoing (CallStyle callType 2, or the ringing context linked to an ongoing notification within APP_CALL_LINK_WINDOW), ended (the in-call notification removed, or the ringing one removed without a link).

answer_mode.description: direct: HandLive holds a background-activity-start exemption (its Accessibility service is bound) and sends the answer intent itself; tap: Answer posts a tap-to-answer notification on the phone.

audio.description: Where the app call's audio is: always phone in v1 (mac is reserved).

started_at.description: When the context was created (Android clock).

answered_at.description: When a ringing context became ongoing; null while ringing, for a context created ongoing, and for a call that ended as declined, missed or unknown.

end_reason.description: Only when state = ended: ended (the in-call notification was removed), declined (HandLive sent the decline), unknown (HandLive sent the answer but no in-call notification followed, or the listener was lost mid-call; answered_at stays null), missed (otherwise).

allOf.description: ended_at and end_reason are set exactly when state = ended.
controls.answer and controls.decline need a ringing call.
A ringing call, or one that ended as declined, missed or unknown, was never ongoing: no answered_at.
